card.name: Inside new brand drug names
card.fires_on: Final or middle pieces of invented brand drug names (e.g. CAMCEVI, MARGENZA, REVTORPYK) in warnings sections, just before verbs like "can cause" or "may cause".

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: Last piece of a capitalized brand name used as the subject of a warning sentence.
modes.example: Embryo-Fetal Toxicity: REVTORPY<<K>> can cause fetal harm.

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: An early or middle piece of a brand name, before the rest of the name follows.
modes.example: Prior to initiating<< AL>>YFTREK, obtain liver function
